dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: Shh! You'll get me yelled at by my father...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: I start trembling whenever I think of what happened before... I don't dare to have any ideas at this point...

dialogues.speaker: Saimon Jirou
dialogues.text: I'll just tend to the fields, and who knows? Maybe one day luck will come my way.
